events.summaryText: ## New Features - Opt-in `instant_interrupt` lets new input steer Codex during model responses or long-running code-mode calls. (#48135, #48141) - New sessions get a compact welcome screen and consistent headers, with occasional tips during and after turns. (#48513, #48562, #48352) - The warnings viewer dismisses reviewed warnings when closed; press `k` to keep one for later.
